pages.title: Goal
pages.text:
**Goal:** run one rite and one travel tool the Spirit Codex already diagrams.\
You need the **Spirit Codex**; those shapes live there, not here.\
Stone Font, Listening Pit, Rite Circle, Voice Ring, Shatter Array, Way Gate and Far Gate are Spirit Codex shapes. Whisker does not reprint them.

pages.title: March travel
pages.text:
The Gate Drum is the portable way into the March. Use it empty-handed and play the Gate Rite: hit the falling beats on A, S, D, F. Land 60% and it opens; no Pulse needed.\
Bind a return compass before you go. `/tribalpower gate list` names later gates.

pages.title: Check
pages.text: **Check:** one Font or Pit from the Spirit Codex diagram produces an output. If it stays silent, crouch and right-click with the Spirit Codex.
